title.zh: 将北阿古桑 Jabonga Cuyago 描笼涯的 Jabonga 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Cuyago 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Jabonga National High School Annex in Barangay Cuyago, Jabonga, Agusan del Norte from the Jabonga National High School in Barangay Poblacion, Jabonga, Agusan del Norte and Converting the same into an Independent National High School to be known as the Cuyago National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Jabonga National High School Annex in Barangay Cuyago, Jabonga, Agusan del Norte from the Jabonga National High School in Barangay Poblacion, Jabonga, Agusan del Norte and Converting the same into an Independent National High School to be known as the Cuyago National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu của Trường Trung học Jabonga Quốc gia tại Barangay Cuyago, Đô thị Jabonga, Tỉnh Agusan del Norte khỏi Trường Trung học Jabonga Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Cuyago Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขตของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Jabonga แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Cuyago เทศบาล Jabonga จังหวัด Agusan del Norte ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Jabonga แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Cuyago แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Jabonga Nasional di Barangay Cuyago, Kotamadya Jabonga, Provinsi Agusan del Norte dari Sekolah Menengah Jabonga Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Cuyago Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Jabonga Kebangsaan di Barangay Cuyago, Perbandaran Jabonga, Wilayah Agusan del Norte daripada Sekolah Menengah Jabonga Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Cuyago Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The existing Jabonga National High School Annex in Barangay Cuyago, Jabonga, Agusan del Norte is hereby separated from the Jabonga National High School in Barangay Poblacion, Jabonga, Agusan del Norte and the same is hereby converted into a national high school to be known as the Cuyago National High School.
The Secretary of Education Culture and Sports - shall issue the necessary rules, orders and circulars to implement the provisions of this Act.
All personnel, records, assets and properties, funds and obligations of the Jabonga National High School Annex are hereby transferred to the Cuyago National High School.

The amount necessary for the initial implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriation of the Jabonga National High School - Cuyago Annex. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the continuous operation and maintenance of the Cuyago National High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
